How often the controller evaluates all pairs for automatic watering.
Enter a value from 5 minutes to 24 hours.
Shared upstream ball valve driven by the servo on the boost rail.
Enter a value from 100 to 5000 ms.
Enter a value from 0 to 5000 ms.
Enter a value from 0 to 10000 ms.

How long the controller actively drives the servo toward the open or shut end position. Increase this if the valve does not reliably reach its stop. Keep it only as long as needed, because the servo stays powered during this time.

Extra wait time after servo motion finishes before watering is allowed to start. This gives the valve time to stop oscillating and lets water pressure settle. Increase it if flow starts too early right after opening.

How long the controller keeps the valve open after watering stops before closing it again. A longer hold avoids repeated open and close cycles when runs happen close together. A shorter hold saves power and closes the supply sooner.
Jog the servo in small steps, define the safe pulse range, and store the open and shut positions for this valve linkage.
